parameters.name: AlertName
parameters.description: The name of the alert.

parameters.name: AlertStatus
parameters.description: The status of the alert.

parameters.name: AlertTitle
parameters.description: The title of the alert.

parameters.name: AlertType
parameters.description: The type of the alert.

parameters.name: AlertUuid
parameters.description: The unique ID of the alert.

parameters.name: AssetId
parameters.description: The ID of the asset.

parameters.name: AssetName
parameters.description: The name of the asset.

parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: The page number. The value must be greater than or equal to 1.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end of the time range to query. This value is a UNIX timestamp representing the number of milliseconds that have elapsed since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC.

parameters.name: EntityId
parameters.description: The ID of the entity.

parameters.name: EntityName
parameters.description: The name of the entity.

parameters.name: IsDefend
parameters.description:
Specifies whether the threat is defended. Valid values:

- `0`: detected

- `1`: blocked

parameters.name: LabelType
parameters.description:
The alert type. Valid values:

- `system`: An alert generated from aggregated analysis

- `custom`: An alert generated from custom analysis

- `cfw`: firewall

- `waf`: web application firewall

- `edr`: endpoint detection and response

- `other`: other

parameters.name: Level
parameters.description:
The threat levels. This parameter is a JSON array. Valid values:

- `serious`: high

- `suspicious`: medium

- `remind`: low

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Maximum value: 100.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region where the data management center of the threat analysis feature resides. You are required to specify this parameter based on the region where your assets reside. Valid values:

- `cn-hangzhou`: Your assets reside in the Chinese mainland or Hong Kong (China).

- `ap-southeast-1`: Your assets reside outside the Chinese mainland.

parameters.name: RoleFor
parameters.description: The ID of the user who is used to switch the account to view the data of the member.

parameters.name: RoleType
parameters.description:
The view type of the alert. Valid values:

- `0`: current account

- `1`: all accounts

parameters.name: Source
parameters.description: The source of the alert.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The beginning of the time range to query. This value is a UNIX timestamp representing the number of milliseconds that have elapsed since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC.

parameters.name: SubUserId
parameters.description: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account that is associated with the alert.
